subject.title: fix(session-memory): forward hook config model to LLM slug generator

question: Should OpenClaw support `hooks.internal.entries.session-memory.model` as the hook-level model selector for LLM slug generation?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the merge intentionally activates a previously ignored passthrough config key that can route calls to a different provider/model on upgrade.

options.title: Support the hook-level model key
options.body: Merge this narrow implementation and treat `session-memory.model` as the documented config contract for slug generation.

options.title: Require broader config documentation first
options.body: Hold merge until the public docs or release notes explicitly describe the new supported hook key and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Do not support this key
options.body: Close or redesign the PR if maintainers want slug model selection to stay on a different provider/config surface.

recommendation.title: Support the hook-level model key
recommendation.body: Merge this narrow implementation and treat `session-memory.model` as the documented config contract for slug generation.
